name: Jurin, Leading the Charge — +1/+0 for each creature the player it is attacking controls
notes: Fixed in two places: the subject 'each creature you control attacking a player' reached nobody (buildAppliesToFromText, cards-text-utils.js, now reads it as an attacker), and in the parser's for-each boost (cards-parser.js) 'that player controls' after 'attacking a player' is the defending player's, which _computeForEachCount reads. Each creature counts the creatures of the player it attacks. Memory: project_for_each_c3_measurable_and_by_hand_2026-10-14.

scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.
